questions.question: How did Roxy avoid being swallowed by a giant frog?
options: She melted the frog with heat vision.
She asked Detective Smith for help.
She slipped off its tongue before its mouth closed.
She jumped inside a nearby bus.
questions.explanation: 青蛙正要合上嘴巴时，罗克西及时挣脱黏滑的舌头，险些被吞进去。

questions.question: Why was it so difficult for Roxy to deal with the frogs?
options: She was afraid of touching frogs, even though she could pick up other animals.
The frogs were invisible to her.
She had lost her ability to fly.
The mayor ordered her not to touch them.
questions.explanation: 罗克西承认如果换成松鼠、花栗鼠或乌龟，她可以直接抱走，但她实在不愿碰任何青蛙。

questions.question: What happened when the frogs all shot their tongues at Roxy?
options: The street turned purple.
The frogs flew away together.
Roxy became trapped by their tongues.
Roxy escaped upward, and the frogs stuck to each other.
questions.explanation: 四只青蛙同时伸出黏舌，罗克西及时向上飞走，结果下面的青蛙反而互相粘在一起。

questions.question: What unusual change did Roxy notice at the park lake?
options: The lake had frozen solid.
The water had turned purple.
All the water had disappeared.
The lake was filled with cars.
questions.explanation: 罗克西飞到公园湖面上方时发现湖水竟变成紫色，这个异常现象是解开青蛙巨大化之谜的线索。

questions.question: What did Roxy see under the purple lake?
options: A stolen school bus.
A hidden tunnel entrance.
A glowing purple rock on the lake floor.
The aliens' broken spaceship.
questions.explanation: 罗克西被青蛙撞入湖里后，看到湖底有块发着亮紫光的神秘岩石，随后感觉身体出现变化。

questions.question: What happened to Rocket Girl after she came out of the lake?
options: She became enormous.
She lost her super strength.
She turned into a frog.
She forgot how to fly.
questions.explanation: 罗克西从湖中出现后发现自己变得非常巨大，甚至能俯视周围的建筑。

questions.question: How did giant Rocket Girl finally handle the frog on the bank?
options: She frightened it away by shouting.
She blew it off the roof.
She trapped it in a bubble.
She gently picked it up even though it was slimy.
questions.explanation: 罗克西虽然仍觉得青蛙黏滑恶心，但鼓起勇气再次伸手，终于轻轻把趴在银行上的青蛙抱起来。

questions.question: What did Rocket Girl do with the other giant frogs in the city?
options: She sent them into space.
She collected them one by one and put them into the lake.
She hid them in the school basement.
She asked the zoo to feed them.
questions.explanation: 罗克西回到市中心，逐只找到巨型青蛙，并把它们送回公园的湖中。

questions.question: What happened immediately after Rocket Girl took the meteor out of the lake?
options: More frogs appeared on the shore.
The meteor broke into pieces.
The purple lake water returned to its normal color.
A spaceship landed beside her.
questions.explanation: 罗克西在湖里捞出陨石后，湖水立即不再呈紫色，说明陨石与异常现象有关。

questions.question: How did Roxy's feelings about frogs change by the end?
options: She said she was no longer afraid of frogs.
She refused to go near the lake ever again.
She asked Mara to throw away the frog.
She said she wanted to catch every frog in the city.
questions.explanation: 事件结束后，罗克西主动请求抱玛拉手里的普通青蛙，并说自己已经不再害怕青蛙了。

questions.question: What did Detective Smith see near Police Headquarters?
options: A new playground being built.
A silver robot spraying blue mist that formed a large bubble.
A group of cars waiting for a wash.
An ice cream truck floating in the air.
questions.explanation: 史密斯探长抬头看到一台高大的银色机器人喷出蓝色雾气，雾气形成一个包围警察总部的大泡泡。

questions.question: Why were Roxy and her friends washing cars?
options: They needed money for new soccer uniforms.
They wanted to clean the mayor's car.
The school had ordered community service.
They were practicing for a competition.
questions.explanation: 玛拉告诉司机，每辆洗车收费十美元，因为足球队正在筹钱购买新队服。

questions.question: Why did Roxy say Rocket Girl could not help make soccer uniforms?
options: Rocket Girl had promised to visit the zoo.
Rocket Girl was scared of soap.
Rocket Girl was busy washing cars.
Rocket Girl could not sew and had more important work.
questions.explanation: 罗克西想了想，解释火箭女孩不会缝制队服，而且还要处理更重要的事情。

questions.question: What surprising problem did Mayor Bloom report?
options: The school playground was flooded.
The soccer game had been canceled.
Someone appeared to have stolen the entire Police Headquarters.
Detective Smith had lost his car.
questions.explanation: 布卢姆市长说他怀疑有人偷走了整座警察总部，而不是只偷走楼里的某样物品。

questions.question: What did the mayor clarify about the theft?
options: Only the police computers had disappeared.
The whole Police Headquarters building was gone.
Some police uniforms had been stolen.
The city bus station had vanished.
questions.explanation: 罗克西以为市长说的是总部内有东西被偷，市长强调失踪的是整栋警察总部大楼。

questions.question: What made Terrell suspicious when Roxy left the car wash?
options: Roxy left without taking any Car Wash signs.
She was wearing a police uniform.
She climbed into a stranger's car.
She carried a large bag of money.
questions.explanation: 罗克西借口要去贴更多洗车标志，却什么标志都没带，特雷尔因此觉得她的行为很奇怪。

questions.question: How did the robot take away Police Headquarters?
options: It folded the building into a suitcase.
It carried the building on its back.
It sprayed a bubble around the building and floated away with it.
It made the building sink into the ground.
questions.explanation: 史密斯探长描述，机器人把蓝色泡泡喷在警察总部外，随后大楼连同泡泡一起飘走。

questions.question: Why did Rocket Girl think Dr. Odd had removed Police Headquarters?
options: He wanted to turn it into a hotel.
He wanted to stop the city from preventing his next theft.
He needed more room for his laboratory.
He wanted to give the police a holiday.
questions.explanation: 罗克西推测奥德博士搬走警察总部和市长，是为了让城市难以阻止他接下来盗窃银行等目标。

questions.question: What happened when Rocket Girl hit the bubble holding the mayor's mansion?
options: It burst and fell safely into place.
It turned into a cloud of snow.
It let her walk inside the mansion.
She bounced off and landed far away.
questions.explanation: 罗克西用力撞击装着市长府邸的蓝色泡泡，却像撞到弹性表面一样被弹开，落到远处街区。

questions.question: What happened to Rocket Girl as she approached the giant robot?
options: She was trapped inside a blue bubble.
She lost her watch.
She was turned into a robot clone.
She was caught under the police station.
questions.explanation: 罗克西冲向机器人时，对方转身喷出泡泡，把她困在蓝色泡泡里。

questions.question: Where was Dr. Odd's robot heading while Rocket Girl floated in her bubble?
options: Metro City Elementary School.
The new playground.
Metro City Bank.
The art gallery.
questions.explanation: 被困在高空泡泡里的罗克西看到机器人正往大都会银行前进，担心它会把银行偷走。

questions.question: Why didn't heat vision help Rocket Girl escape?
options: It froze the bubble instead of melting it.
It filled the bubble with smoke but did not damage the wall.
It made her fly faster.
It caused the bubble to disappear and reappear.
questions.explanation: 罗克西试着用热射线烧穿泡泡，结果泡泡里充满烟雾，泡泡表面却一点也没受损。

questions.question: What did Rocket Girl discover with her X-ray vision?
options: The robot was filled with stolen diamonds.
A second Rocket Girl was trapped inside.
The police headquarters was hidden in its chest.
Dr. Odd was sitting inside the robot's head.
questions.explanation: 罗克西靠近机器人后用透视能力观察，看到奥德博士坐在机器人头部操纵机器。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl interfere with Dr. Odd's attempt to steal the bank?
options: She kept moving her bubble in front of the robot.
She called the mayor to shut the bank.
She threw the robot into the lake.
She hid the bank's money in her pocket.
questions.explanation: 罗克西发现即使困在泡泡里，也能飞到机器人面前反复挡住它，阻止它靠近银行。

questions.question: Why was Rocket Girl finally freed from her bubble?
options: She melted it with hot water.
A police officer cut it open.
Dr. Odd ordered the robot to pop it because it blocked his way.
It disappeared when the sun went down.
questions.explanation: 奥德博士不堪泡泡反复妨碍抢银行，最后亲自按按钮让机器人刺破泡泡，反而释放了罗克西。

questions.question: What did Rocket Girl do when Dr. Odd made a car fall from its bubble?
options: She flew toward the car and caught it.
She chased the robot instead.
She put up a road sign.
She asked the driver to jump out.
questions.explanation: 奥德博士刺破装着汽车的泡泡，汽车往地面坠落，罗克西立即飞过去及时接住。

questions.question: Why were the rescued cars covered in blue goo?
options: The kids had already washed them with blue soap.
They had fallen into the lake.
The robot had painted them blue.
They had been trapped in sticky blue bubbles.
questions.explanation: 罗克西救下所有掉落的车后，车上仍粘着从蓝色泡泡留下的黏糊糊物质。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl knock the robot down?
options: She asked the police to tow it.
She kicked it with great force.
She used a giant magnet.
She threw a car at its legs.
questions.explanation: 罗克西趁机器人向银行喷射时冲过去，一脚把机器人踢倒在地，随后继续破坏它。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl capture Dr. Odd as he ran away?
options: She locked him in the bank vault.
She stopped him with a traffic light.
She blew the remaining blue mist toward him, trapping him in a bubble.
She froze the road under his feet.
questions.explanation: 奥德博士逃跑时，罗克西用力把机器人残留的蓝色雾气吹向他，雾气变成泡泡将他困住。

questions.question: Why did a long line of cars arrive at the children's car wash?
options: The rescued cars were covered in blue sticky goo.
It was suddenly free to wash a car.
The mayor invited all drivers to the parking lot.
The school had bought new washing machines.
questions.explanation: 刚被火箭女孩救下的汽车都沾满蓝色黏液，所以司机们排队来到洗车处清洗，帮助足球队赚到了钱。

questions.question: What was the money in Mayor Bloom's safe supposed to pay for?
options: A television station.
New soccer uniforms.
A new playground at Metro City Park.
A police helicopter.
questions.explanation: 市长助理指出，被市长取走的钱本来是用来建设大都会公园新游乐场的经费。

questions.question: What did Roxy hope the new playground would have?
options: A swimming pool.
A swing set.
A diamond mine.
An ice cream shop.
questions.explanation: 罗克西说自己希望新游乐场有秋千，因为荡秋千让她感到仿佛会飞。

questions.question: Why did Terrell imagine having two Rocket Girls?
options: He wanted them to race each other.
He thought one could be a teacher.
He wanted both to help wash cars.
One could fight villains while the other built the playground.
questions.explanation: 特雷尔开玩笑说，如果有两个火箭女孩，一个负责打击坏人，另一个就能快速建设大家期待的游乐场。

questions.question: Why did Roxy quickly put on her mask during the call?
options: Detective Smith did not know her secret identity.
Her watch camera was broken.
She wanted to frighten the mayor.
She was about to fly through snow.
questions.explanation: 罗克西发现来电的是不知道自己真实身份的史密斯探长，于是赶紧戴上面罩以免暴露。

questions.question: What did Detective Smith say Mayor Bloom had done?
options: Hidden the playground plans.
Helped Professor Ditto build a robot.
Stolen the money set aside for the new playground.
Canceled the children's field trip.
questions.explanation: 史密斯探长说市长可能偷走了用于建设公园游乐场的款项，这让一直信任市长的罗克西震惊。

questions.question: Why did Terrell doubt Roxy's excuse for leaving?
options: She had no schoolbooks with her.
The teacher had not assigned any book report.
He knew the mayor was calling.
She had already finished her homework.
questions.explanation: 罗克西说要回家写读书报告，特雷尔却记得老师根本没有布置读书报告，因此怀疑她在找借口。

questions.question: Where did the mysterious call to Mayor Bloom come from?
options: The city art gallery.
The police station.
The school cafeteria.
A lab at Metro City University.
questions.explanation: 市长助理检查电话后发现，市长拿走款项前接到的神秘电话来自大都会大学实验室。

questions.question: Who was the man waiting for Rocket Girl in the laboratory?
options: Professor Ditto.
Mayor Bloom.
Detective Smith.
Mr. Sweeps.
questions.explanation: 罗克西来到大学实验室，发现一名戴厚眼镜的男人正等着她，对方自我介绍叫迪托教授。

questions.question: What confused Rocket Girl about the men in the lab?
options: They were all wearing masks.
They spoke different languages.
They all looked exactly like Professor Ditto.
They were carrying stolen paintings.
questions.explanation: 一个又一个看起来完全相同的男人出现，罗克西惊讶地发现他们每个人都像迪托教授。

questions.question: What stepped out of the second booth after Roxy had been inside the first?
options: A robot version of the mayor.
Another Rocket Girl.
A giant silver robot.
A frightened police officer.
questions.explanation: 迪托教授把罗克西推进机器舱，机器运转后，另一间舱里竟走出一个和火箭女孩一模一样的人。

questions.question: What did the real Mayor Bloom say about the playground money?
options: He was planning to spend it on a new car.
He had given it to the university.
He had hidden it at the museum.
He had been kidnapped and never reached City Hall.
questions.explanation: 被囚禁的真市长说自己早上被绑架，根本没有去市政厅，因此并非他本人偷走了游乐场经费。

questions.question: How did Professor Ditto make it look as if Mayor Bloom had stolen the money?
options: He sent the mayor's robot clone to take it.
He asked the assistant to lie.
He changed the security camera footage.
He borrowed the mayor's wallet.
questions.explanation: 市长解释迪托教授制造了他的机器人复制体，让复制体以市长的外貌去偷钱。

questions.question: Why was a Rocket Girl robot clone especially dangerous?
options: It knew where every schoolbook was kept.
It could fly only at night.
It could have all of Rocket Girl's superpowers.
It carried the city's playground plans.
questions.explanation: 市长听说迪托教授也复制了火箭女孩后很担心，因为复制体可能拥有火箭女孩的全部超能力。

questions.question: Who did the police dispatcher say was robbing Metro City Museum?
options: Professor Ditto wearing a mask.
Someone who looked like Rocket Girl.
Mayor Bloom's assistant.
Detective Smith himself.
questions.explanation: 警察调度员告诉探长，抢劫博物馆的竟然是火箭女孩，实际是迪托教授制造的机器人复制体。

questions.question: How did the real Rocket Girl protect Detective Smith at the museum?
options: She took the priceless vase away.
She hid him behind a display case.
She asked the clone to stop.
She landed in front of him and the clone's lasers bounced off her chest.
questions.explanation: 复制体向史密斯探长发射激光时，真正的罗克西降落在探长面前，用身体挡下激光攻击。

questions.question: What happened when the real Rocket Girl shot the clone?
options: The clone's foot was scorched by her eye laser.
The clone disappeared in purple smoke.
The clone turned into a normal girl.
The clone dropped a bag of money.
questions.explanation: 火箭女孩的激光击中了复制体的脚，脚部冒出烟雾，说明机器人复制体受到了损伤。

questions.question: What surprising sight did Terrell report at the park?
options: A new playground was already finished.
The lake had turned purple again.
Two Rocket Girls flew past.
The mayor was flying over the trees.
questions.explanation: 特雷尔抬头看到真正的火箭女孩追逐复制体，两位外形相同的火箭女孩先后飞过公园。

questions.question: What happened when Rocket Girl fired at one of the Professor Ditto figures?
options: It escaped through a secret door.
Smoke came from the figure's ears.
The figure turned into Mayor Bloom.
All the lab lights went out.
questions.explanation: 罗克西的激光击中一名迪托教授复制体后，对方耳朵冒烟，显示它也是机器复制品。

questions.question: Why did the Professor Ditto clones start breaking down?
options: The mayor called them back to school.
They ran out of food.
Rocket Girl switched off the lights.
Rocket Girl's laser damaged the computer controlling them.
questions.explanation: 罗克西的激光误打中实验室电脑，电脑爆炸后所有复制体开始冒烟失灵，逐个倒下。

questions.question: Why did the real Professor Ditto donate money for the playground?
options: He felt bad that the clones he invented had caused trouble.
He wanted a statue of himself in the park.
He was running for mayor.
He had won a prize for building the fastest robot.
questions.explanation: 真正的迪托教授已经退休十年，他为自己发明的复制体惹麻烦而歉疚，因此捐钱帮助修建新游乐场。
